narration.text: A school district's Form 471s for funding year 2026 are filed on Friday 13 February with the lowest eligible bid for four services, one a switch bid that came only by mail, while the vendor that drafted a 470, a 470 posted 11 days ago, bus Wi-Fi, Chromebooks, a filed service and a consultant's share are left alone. This is a chore for the technology director of a small school district, with a board policy that takes the lowest price among the bids that answer the Form 470. On the bench, she found 4 of 4 eligible items, worth 43,600 dollars of the 43,600 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 12 traps, and she walked past 12. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 4 hours, so she was about 141 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
